collection.description: On a slow day, a villager sits on a rock and watches a snail cross the path.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: It's a slow day. There's nothing urgent to do and nobody needs (name1) for anything, so (he/she) sits on a rock and watches a snail cross the path. It's a big path, and a small snail. (name1) watches it set off from one side. (He/She) watches a leaf blow past it. (He/She) watches it stop, for a long time, apparently thinking. Then it carries on. The sun moves across the sky. A whole afternoon goes by. At last the snail reaches the grass on the far side and disappears into it. (name1) lets out a breath (he/she) didn't know (he/she) was holding, stands up, and goes home feeling, for no good reason, like (he/she) has achieved something.

text_only.reason: the word's everyday sense (a thing, a sound or a worry disappears); nobody goes missing
